## Overview
Free audio guide companion pages for Lokali travel app.
Static HTML for search engine and AI crawler indexing.
Multi-language support (44 languages).

## Download the app
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.lokali.travel&pli=1

## Guidelines
- All pages use hreflang for language alternates
- Each page includes schema.org markup (TouristAttraction/TouristDestination)
- RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu
- SEO-optimized meta titles and descriptions per language
